<div class="inner-page">

<p class="section__label">News · Doctoral thesis · from the TAMARYS network</p>

<h1 class="thesis-h1">Plasma-assisted combustion, from hydrocarbons to hydrogen</h1>

<p class="thesis-lead">On <strong>25 June 2026</strong>, <strong>Jean-Baptiste Perrin-Terrin</strong>
defended his doctoral thesis, <em>“Plasma-assisted combustion in low emissions burners: from
hydrocarbons to hydrogen,”</em> at CentraleSupélec. The work was funded by the ERC
<strong>GreenBlue</strong> project and addresses a question central to cleaner high-temperature
energy: how plasma discharges can assist low-emission combustion, from hydrocarbon to hydrogen flames.</p>

<div class="thesis-hero" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr;">
  <div class="thesis-facts" aria-label="Thesis details">
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Defended</span><span class="v">25 June 2026, 14:30 · CentraleSupélec, Théâtre Rousseau</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Title</span><span class="v">Plasma-assisted combustion in low emissions burners: from hydrocarbons to hydrogen</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Supervision</span><span class="v">Christophe Laux (supervisor) · Sébastien Ducruix (co-supervisor) · Philippe Scouflaire (co-advisor)</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Funding</span><span class="v">ERC GreenBlue project</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<p>The defence was announced to the <a href="/network/networks/tamarys.html">TAMARYS</a> research
network, which brings together French laboratories working on radiation, extreme-environment
materials and high-temperature systems. As the announcement put it, the work advances both the
understanding of fundamental effects and their practical implementation, and it matters for the
cleaner energy solutions of the future. Reported here with the agreement of the network's
coordination, following <a href="/events-news/news/mireia-sainz-thesis-2026.html">Mireia Sainz's
thesis</a> in June.</p>

<p class="thesis-back"><a href="/news/index.html">&larr; All news</a></p>

</div>
